query: What happens when Samsung Galaxy S7 buyers contact the seller or manufacturer about a faulty phone or a refund?
search_text: What happens when buyers contact the seller or manufacturer about a faulty phone or a refund?

rows.text: Bad phone seller won't stand behind.. Phone overheats and shuts off constantly. Seller won't do anything about it because of limited warranty. Buyers beware.

They didn't respond. I contacted Amazon and they also contacted the seller. No response. I called the seller, no one picked up the phone and the voice mail box was full. Spend the extra cash and get this from a different seller. I'm out a lot of money for a faulty phone. For more information about this defect google "vertical lines in screen," - it seems fairly common and most people have a similar story.

Good Phone at a good price until problems occur. The phone was new in original At&t packaging, as advertised. Transfer of contacts from my S6 active went smoothly. Have used the phone for a couple of weeks now and the battery life is as it should be in a new phone. Overall very happy with the product and price. Update: After less than 3 months the phone developed red lines on the screen that are now multiplying. Contacted the seller, was told that I could only return the phone withing 30 days and to contact Samsung. Buyer Beware.
Not happy with purchase but happy with refund. The phone wasn't as I expected and I was given a full refund

SCREEN OR PHONE SEEMS FAULTY. Just unwrapped and set up last night, started to use it . It did not fall and screen shows part blank grey in colour. Very disappointed. Need refund or customer servixe to contact me.

FAULTY CELLPHONE!!. The seller sent me a defective cellphone, the battery is a desastre does not last more than 3 hours. The announcement said "like new, comes in original packaging and original accessories" the cellphone is 8/10, did not bring original packaging and headphones are a cheap imitation. I am very angry and will return the cellphone.

Amazon just do not care. They will blame the seller and tell you there is nothing they can do if their sellers are criminals. The worst part: Amazon Customer Service is the worst I have ever seen. Each time you call they tell you must wait for a week and they will call you back, but they never do. Some of Amazon Customer Service representatives assured me I would be refunded, but I was never refunded, and after I called again, they would just tell me that the person who talked to me before did not know what he was saying and that they should train better their representatives... Basically they will make you waste a ton of time calling them several times, but they will never return your calls or refund you, even after they assure you that you will be refunded. After this phone, I abandoned Amazon.
Didn't work access seller refuses to give refund!. Didn't work and seller refuses to give refund
BEWARE !!!. Do not buy from this seller ! Phone died after a month of light use. Does not turn on again... Tried contacting seller, but no response...

NO WARRANTY even though the product is advertised as NEW. The phone is being sold at a substantial discount as NEW, but manufacturer (Samsung) says that it is not under warranty. Refurbished phones are sold by other sellers in a similar prices range, so the seller lies in his description to move the product and as such should be banned from conducting business on Amazon.
phone does not work . I want a refund. Samsung Galaxy S7
Avoid. Bad experience with the phone and the seller.

DO NOT PURCHASE THIS PHONE. I had this phone less than a year. Never dropped the phone, had a protective cae and a glass screen protector and randomly had a dot on the screen with a line running thrpugh it, showing that the lcd had a defect in it. I contacted the seller and do not recommend anyone waste their time on purchasing this device.

Galaxy S7 = Good / Seller = Bad. There is no disputing that the S7 was and is still a great phone. The only catch with this listing is that the seller's are trying to pawn off third tier equipment as "nearly new" . The Amazon listing states, " Product works and looks like new. Backed by the 90-day Amazon Renewed Guarantee." So far I'm working on my second return. Kiss Electronics sent me one where the screen had a vertical line running through it, and seller BHHT Deals sent me one that has clearly been used hard with a cracked bezel around the screen and too many dings and dents on the body to be considered "normal wear and tear". There doesn't appear to be any quality control measures when it comes to repackaging used phones, their hoping you'll just take what you're given and move on. Buyer Beware...
Charger faulty. The charger for this phone did not work . I had to switch the charger head with a previous charger I had at home for the codes to work

I looked the problem up on line, tried a few suggested remedies - none of which worked. It was getting late, I was frustrated and figured I would send an email to the seller through Amazon and see what happens. This was roughly 10:30 PM, Eastern Wednesday night. The next day, Thursday, I was at work and I had a response from the seller's rep named Eric. He apologized, said the company would make it right and had already arranged for a replacement to be sent and a return label issued for the defective phone. He indicated that the replacement phone would be sent out priority and I should have it in about 2 days. Well, sure enough, the phone arrived on Saturday as expected. I transferred the info from the defective phone to the new new phone via Smart Switch and the phone works perfectly fine.

The seller did resolve my issue with satisfaction and i now have a working phone at a good. Word of advice, ask to verify the IMEI before purchase. The seller did resolve my issue with satisfaction and i now have a working phone at a good price

Phone did NOT work. Had to call Samsung and argue warranty.. Phone did NOT work. Had to call Samsung and argue warranty. They finally agreed to fix it. Had to send to Samsung and wait a week to get it back. Seems o.k. now. Buyer beware that even though it says New, it is not!
Samsung Galaxy S7. Worked poorly on Verizon, not USA version. Ret'd for refund without any problem from seller.

Galaxy S7 has a battery issue and seller unresponsive.... Have 3 galaxy s7s, they have a bad battery issue so avoid this phone, there are better phones out there. However, this particular seller was unresponsive when I had a problem with the reported condition of the phone. Said condition was good, but fingerprint reader didn't work and would not respond when I told them of the problem. Bad design on the phone, not the seller's issue, but the seller DOES NOT RESPOND AFTER YOU PURCHASE... AVOID BOTH SELLER AND THE GALAXY S7...
